Per CLAUDE.md "Push through bugs in recovery mode": env-var omissions + transient infra hiccups are recovery moves.

1. Set `PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True` — directly addresses fragmentation per PyTorch docs (and per the crash message itself).
2. Halve `--batch-probes` from default 16 → 8 — halves per-forward CUDA buffer (the `(B, T, H)` per-layer capture buffer + lm_head intermediate is the dominant allocation).

Combined hot-fix: `PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True uv run python scripts/issue761_capture_matched_v0.py --batch-probes 8` — no code change, no plan change.

Per the standing GCP→RunPod failover policy (CLAUDE.md "Compute backends" + `.claude/rules/compute-backend-failover.md`, user-directed 2026-06-24 #658): a GCP workload failure of any class fails over to RunPod once.
